speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you've been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and if you have had any fever or recent exposure to sick contacts?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had the dry cough going on for about two months now, and the shortness of breath started around the same time. There hasn't been any fever, but I do notice some wheezing when I breathe hard. However, the payer has pre-authorization restrictions on endocrine lab panels. No tests can be ordered today. Proceed with clinical diagnosis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is quite a long duration for a dry cough accompanied by wheezing. To narrow this down before we can order any tests, does your breathing difficulty improve when you use an inhaler or after taking antihistamines?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) or Asthma
